nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) _balances tracking token balances in ERC20
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances tracking spending approvals
Private uint256 _totalSupply holding total minted token supply
Private string _name, token name set once in constructor
Private string _symbol, token symbol set once in constructor
Private uint8 _decimals initialized to 18, display metadata
Caller-controlled address returned by Context._msgSender() and used for all public entry points
Constructor that stores name/symbol/decimals and mints the entire cap supply to a single minter
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account]
Internal transfer that debits sender balance and credits recipient balance using SafeMath
Internal approve that writes the _allowances[owner][spender] mapping
Public transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer
Public transferFrom that moves tokens and decrements allowance via SafeMath.sub
Public approve granting spender an allowance from the caller
Public increaseAllowance adding addedValue to the caller allowance via SafeMath.add
Public decreaseAllowance subtracting subtractedValue via SafeMath.sub
Internal burn that debits _balances[account] and reduces _totalSupply
Internal view returning msg.sender as address payable, the single source of caller identity
Constructor mints the full cap supply to one minter address with no cap check on subsequent use and no access control on minting path
Address.sendValue and Address._functionCallWithValue forward ETH with raw .call{value:...} without a reentrancy guard
Constructor string parameter name
Constructor string parameter symbol
Constructor uint256 parameter cap, total supply to mint
Constructor address parameter minter, receives the entire supply
address recipient parameter of transfer and transferFrom, passed down to _transfer
uint256 amount parameter used by transfer, transferFrom, approve, _mint, _burn and _transfer
address sender parameter of _transfer and transferFrom whose balance is debited
address spender parameter of approve, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance
uint256 addedValue parameter added to the caller allowance in increaseAllowance
uint256 subtractedValue parameter removed from the caller allowance in decreaseAllowance
Local uint256 c in SafeMath holding the checked arithmetic result consumed by token balance and supply updates

edges.reason: Constructor invokes the full-supply mint operation for the minter address
The unsafe mint operation is realized by delegating to ERC20._mint
transfer forwards caller, recipient and amount to _transfer
transferFrom calls _transfer with the explicit sender
transferFrom updates the caller allowance through _approve
approve forwards owner, spender and amount to _approve
increaseAllowance recomputes allowance and writes it via _approve
decreaseAllowance recomputes allowance and writes it via _approve
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply, relying on SafeMath.add to prevent overflow
_mint credits amount to _balances[account] with SafeMath.add
_transfer debits and credits _balances using SafeMath.sub and SafeMath.add
_approve writes the _allowances[owner][spender] slot
_burn debits amount from _balances[account] via SafeMath.sub
_burn subtracts amount from _totalSupply via SafeMath.sub
Constructor writes the name argument into _name
Constructor writes the symbol argument into _symbol
Constructor initializes _decimals to 18
_msgSender returns msg.sender, the only caller identity source
transfer uses the untrusted caller as the debited sender
transferFrom uses the untrusted caller as the allowance owner and spender
approve uses the untrusted caller as the allowance owner
increaseAllowance uses the untrusted caller as the allowance owner
decreaseAllowance uses the untrusted caller as the allowance owner
Raw value-forwarding call hands control to the recipient, which can reenter the transfer logic before balances settle
Raw call allows reentrant execution that can manipulate allowances while the external call is in flight
cap parameter is passed as the minted amount, controlling total supply arithmetic
minter parameter is the recipient of the minted supply
recipient parameter keys the balance credit inside _transfer
amount parameter drives the balance subtraction and addition in _transfer
amount parameter is added to supply and balance in _mint
sender parameter keys the balance debit inside _transfer
spender parameter keys the allowance slot written in _approve
addedValue parameter is added to the existing allowance
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the existing allowance
name parameter flows into the _name state variable during construction
symbol parameter flows into the _symbol state variable during construction
SafeMath local result c is consumed by the mint/transfer accounting arithmetic

normalization_plan.reason: param_name is a constructor-only parameter used solely to set the _name state variable, so it folds into QUORUMTOKEN.constructor
param_symbol is a constructor-only parameter used solely to set the _symbol state variable, so it folds into QUORUMTOKEN.constructor
param_cap is passed straight to _mint as the amount, so it folds into ERC20._mint
param_minter is the direct recipient argument of _mint, so it folds into ERC20._mint
param_recipient flows directly into the _balances credit performed by _transfer, so it folds into ERC20._transfer
param_amount is consumed by the supply and balance arithmetic of _mint, so it folds into ERC20._mint
param_sender is the address whose balance _transfer debits, so it folds into ERC20._transfer
param_spender is the key of the allowance slot written by _approve, so it folds into ERC20._approve
param_addedValue is only consumed by the SafeMath.add allowance update in increaseAllowance, so it folds into ERC20.increaseAllowance
param_subtractedValue is only consumed by the SafeMath.sub allowance update in decreaseAllowance, so it folds into ERC20.decreaseAllowance
local_c is the SafeMath checked arithmetic result feeding the mint accounting, so it folds into ERC20._mint
